notes.title: Union of Gnomes is out in full release!
notes.notes:
Greetings, comrades!

The hour has come! The gnomes are regrouping and returning — stronger, meaner, and funnier than ever before!

[previewyoutube=yHzrdwKKvso;full][/previewyoutube]

Welcome the full release of Union of Gnomes, packed with content, new features, and unexpected surprises.

What’s new:
[list]
[*] New mission: “Snow White’s Villa”—a dark fairy tale with a twisted ending
[*] 7 new monsters
[*] 3 new bosses: The Little Mermaid (yes, she’s really mean), Snow White, and… someone else we won’t spoil just yet
[*] 4 fresh new quests
[*] 10 new maps
[*] 2 secret mechanics leading to a hidden boss
[*] 1 hidden comic-style cutscene at the end
[*] Combat tutorial right at the start — no boring text dumps!
[*] New mission: “Fatport” — harbor drama, and gnomes in peril
[*] Final comic cutscene — the grand story conclusion
[/list]
In honor of the release — [b]35% OFF![/b] A great deal. Grab it now!

We also decided to create a bundle with another awesome gnome game, so you can get a double dose of gnomish madness and mayhem in one go! Don’t miss this great chance to grab two games at once with a sweet 10% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53222/Youve_been_Gnomed 
 
Gnomes is a turn-based tower defense with deep roguelike progression. Build, farm and defend your village as you push deeper into goblin-infested territory. Unlock powerful upgrades and craft your environment to survive the endless goblin horde.

Remember: by buying the game, you’re supporting a noble cause — the fight for freedom and independence — values shared by all humankind… and gnomekind.

Please leave a review on Steam — your support keeps us motivated and helps us grow the game!

Freedom to the Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Get ready to storm the University — the winter update is out!
notes.notes:
Greetings, comrades!

The gnome squad is bravely marching forward to defeat Snow White and claim their long-awaited freedom. Today marks the beginning of a new battle: the attack on the University.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/3be4a5ef2f786b182641dfbbbc3121913bb406f0.png[/img]

It all began here. The University is where Snow White founded her secret society, studying dark magic, performing forbidden rituals, and crafting the song that enslaved the gnomes. To defeat her, you must uncover the truth by finding Snow White's secret diary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/eb7633a398180517a2e50a11a9433c14ab355529.png[/img]

But it won’t be easy! Though Snow White has long since graduated, her dark influence lingers. Living skeletons, enchanted books, monstrous cabbages, young students, and followers of dark magic—all will stand in the way of the brave gnomes.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/LdXQZMN/boss-bomb.gif[/img]

You’ll need all your courage and wit to defeat these foes and make your way to the library, where the ultimate challenge awaits: the Yule Cat. This cunning and devious boss will push your skills to the limit, but the gnomes are no strangers to fighting with everything they’ve got.

[b]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]A new location: [/b]University.
[*] [b]Six new monsters[/b] to challenge your skills.
[*] [b]Four quests[/b] full of intrigue and danger.
[*] [b]A new boss:[/b] the Yule Cat.
[/list]
Update your game, dive into thrilling card battles, and don’t forget to share your feedback with us by leaving a review!

Freedom to the Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Big story update: new missions, cards, and mechanics!
notes.notes:
Greetings, comrades!

Today, we push forward and continue the fight against Snow White and her tyrannical rule of the kingdom! The new update sees our gnomish squad of rebels encounter phantasmagorical Dream Factory, the noisy Southern Market, and more hellish missions that contain the strongest packs of monsters with unfair difficulty levels.  

This is what's new in the update: : 
[list]
[*] 2 story missions;
[*] 1 quest mission;
[*] 1 super-difficult mission;
[*] 9 gnome cards for the collection and 12 new cards in missions;
[*] 8 new monsters and 4 new bosses;
[*] And the Italian language option has been added! 
[/list]

Here are the full details!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hghCjKs/image.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Mission "The Dream Factory"[/b][/h3]
When you arrive at the Dream Factory, you will encounter new enemies and unfair rules that give creatures an advantage, making fights even harder than before.  The gnomes will face off against wrestlers, boxers, and… cheerleaders. If you don't stop them at the root, these fearsome foes can deliver critical blows with their special skills.

For example, the "Ram" boxer moves forward after an attack and uses critical blows while in the first position. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fSxw58W/image.gif[/img]

In the finale, you will battle the Great Oz. Frantically moving around the circus ring and turning your gnomes into all manner of DIFFERENT things, he will crush you. 

[h3][b]South Market Mission[/b][/h3]
This is where gnome goods and wares are sold. Everything is bought and sold here, and some cards can be played for COINS, so you can't do without gold. Additional coins can be taken from monsters, but they will not miss the opportunity to get into your pocket. For example, an enemy can obtain and use a special buff named "Thief", which removes 5 gold from your wallet with each attack against you.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZH93zXR/image.gif[/img]

The South Market has brand new enemies – sellers and shopaholics – all of whom will buy tons of "gnomes" goods and refuse to relinquish their passion for consumerism. Beating them will reward you with VERY powerful cards, VERY sinister curse cards, and COOL goods.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/GtRpmzC/2.gif[/img]

This shopping trip will end in a duel with Couturier Knockoff, who will cut you up with a pair of scissors and leave you to be eaten by his tamed pigeons.

[h3][b]New cards[/b][/h3]
The theme of this act's new cards is combos. We wanted to create more cards that can be combined to obtain powerful effects. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/RPhqw2k/image.gif[/img]

For example, the Rocket card cannot be played, however, upon discarding it, it will inflict a total damage of 10 to all opponents. This is a great card to combo with gnomes discarding other cards. 

We also created cards called "Holy Gnomes." Use them to create a build that will heal you and destroy your enemies with these same healing dwarves. Among these cards, the "Holy Gnomes" grant you a buff that doubles your healing ability, and the "Sinner" gnome grants you a buff that allows you to deal damage with healing. 

Play Union of Gnomes and keep fighting for equality and freedom. Don't forget to write reviews of the game on Steam and talk about it in the Discussions. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team
